results.label: scam
results.text: Hello Mr. Johnson, this is Karen from the Medicare benefits review office. We are updating records for members in your county and just need to confirm your Medicare number. You can call me back at 602-555-0171 whenever convenient.
results.summary: This is a fake Medicare call trying to steal your Medicare number — do not call back or share any information.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi, our billing system refunded you $2,990 instead of $299 by mistake. Could you please send back the $2,691 difference using a Walmart money transfer today? Thank you for helping us fix this.
results.summary: This is a classic overpayment scam trying to trick you into sending your own money by irreversible transfer.

results.label: scam
results.text: Thanks for applying! We would love to move you forward as a data entry assistant. The interview will be done over Google Chat. Before we start, please send a photo of your driver's license and your SSN for the background check.
results.summary: This fake job message is trying to steal your identity — never send your license or Social Security number for a chat interview.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi tenants, we have changed our banking provider. Starting this month please send rent by Zelle to our new account at pm.rentoffice2026@gmail.com. The old account is closed. Thanks!
results.summary: Unverified message tells you to send rent to a new Zelle email address, which is a common rent-payment redirection risk.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hello, this is Dana at Hartley Title. Please note our wire instructions have changed for your closing on Friday. Updated routing and account numbers are attached. Kindly wire the $48,200 down payment by Thursday noon.
results.summary: This looks like the classic closing-cost wire scam where someone poses as the title company and switches the wire details.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi Accounts Payable, please update our remittance details for invoice #7741. Our new bank information is attached. Kindly confirm once changed and process the $12,480 payment this week.
results.summary: This is a classic vendor bank-change request asking you to send $12,480 to new account details, so verify it before paying.

results.label: scam
results.text: We are a licensed digital asset recovery firm. Our records show you may have lost funds in a crypto platform failure. For a small upfront retainer of $450 we can recover up to 95% of your funds.
results.summary: This is a classic crypto recovery scam asking for $450 upfront with an impossible 95% recovery promise.

results.label: scam
results.text: Congratulations, you have been selected to receive a $9,000 federal community grant. There is nothing to repay. A $150 verification fee by prepaid card is required to release the funds.
results.summary: This is a fake grant offer trying to steal $150 from you by prepaid card.

results.label: scam
results.text: We've been trying to reach you about your vehicle's extended warranty. Your coverage is about to lapse. Please call 888-555-0166 so we can go over your options.
results.summary: Unsolicited warranty-lapse warning urging you to call an unknown number is a classic warranty phone scam pattern.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi mum, I dropped my phone in the sink and this is my new number. Can you save it? Also can you help me pay a bill today, my banking app is locked.
results.summary: This looks like the classic 'hi mum' scam asking for bill money from a new number, so do not pay without checking.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hey! Long time no see. I started trading with this platform my aunt recommended and made a decent profit last month, happy to show you how it works if you're curious. No pressure!
results.summary: A friendly reconnect that quickly pitches profitable trading and offers to show you how — a classic investment-scam opener.

results.label: scam
results.text: Your package from Amazon could not be delivered because the address is incomplete. Please reply with your full address and the card on file so we can reship.
results.summary: This is a fake Amazon delivery message trying to steal your address and card details.

results.label: scam
results.text: Your electric company has moved to a new online payment portal. To avoid any interruption of service, please re-enter your payment details at the new portal by Friday: https://srp-billing-portal.com/login
results.summary: This is a fake electric company notice trying to steal your payment details with a Friday shut-off threat.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hello, I am calling from Banner Health. Your brother was admitted after an accident and needs a deposit before surgery. Can you wire $3,000 right now? I can give you the account number.
results.summary: This is a fake hospital emergency call trying to force you to wire $3,000 quickly.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi Linda, this is Bob from Publishers Prize Patrol. You have won $1.2 million and a new Mercedes! Before we deliver the prize we just need you to cover the $890 insurance and tax in advance.
results.summary: You did not win a prize — this is a fake prize notice asking you to pay $890 upfront to get a large prize that doesn't exist.

results.label: scam
results.text: This is a courtesy reminder from the Internal Revenue Service. You are eligible for a reduced settlement of your tax debt. To lock in the discount please call 480-555-0144 and have a payment method ready.
results.summary: This text pretending to be the IRS offering a tax discount for quick payment is a scam.

results.label: scam
results.text: Honey, my business trip hit a problem and my account is frozen here. Can you help me with $1,500 for the hotel until my bank fixes it? I will pay you back as soon as I'm home, I promise.
results.summary: This asks for $1,500 for an emergency and you cannot tell from this message if it is really from someone you know.

results.label: scam
results.text: Your annual subscription of $499.99 for Norton 360 has been renewed and will be charged to your card. If you want to cancel, our support desk at 1-844-555-0112 will assist you with the refund.
results.summary: Fake Norton renewal notice trying to get you to call a scammer number for a refund.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi, this is Tom from your bank's fraud team. We've noticed some transfers on your account. To protect your money we need you to move your funds to a temporary safe account. I'll guide you through it.
results.summary: This is a classic safe-account scam pretending to be your bank to steal your money.

results.label: scam
results.text: This is the Office of Student Aid. Your account shows an unclaimed refund of $1,832. To release it please confirm your bank login and student ID on our secure page.
results.summary: This is a scam pretending to be student aid to steal your bank login and student ID with a fake $1,832 refund.
